blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Ananke, a representation-learning framework that scaffolds latent representations onto a structured product-torus prior, and its flagship visual backbone realization, Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN). By factorizing high-dimensional latent spaces into an orthogonal direct sum of two-dimensional phase planes ( ⨁ k = 1 K ℝ 2 \bigoplus_{k=1}^{K}\mathbb{R}^{2} ), Ananke coordinates feature updates via a decoupled dual-phase continuous flow: skew-symmetric Hamiltonian transport moves features tangentially along energy level sets to preserve semantic phase invariants, while signed gradient dissipation contracts transverse perturbations normally toward target invariant manifolds. For circular potential families with frozen parameters, logarithmic radial feedback yields the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF), an analytical closed-form mapping with exact exponential decay of log-radius error that evaluates in a single forward pass without numerical integration. We establish local input-to-state bounds for level-set deviations and log-radius errors, and characterize the normal hyperbolicity and persistence of the ideal product torus under bounded perturbations. We further formulate the architecture through Lie–Trotter operator splitting, unifying spatial depthwise diffusion with local manifold contraction, and analyze both exact trigonometric flows and hardware-friendly symplectic dual-shear variants. Across natural image benchmarks (CIFAR-100) and clinically challenging endoscopy datasets (Kvasir-v2), CTAN demonstrates exceptional parameter efficiency: an ultra-compact hierarchical model with merely 0.27M parameters achieves 90.52% accuracy on Kvasir-v2, outperforming 25M+ baselines (ResNet-50, DenseNet-161) by nearly two orders of magnitude in capacity, while scaled variants attain 80.32% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Ananke,这是一个表现学习框架,它把潜在的表现放在结构化的产品托拉斯之前,以及它的旗舰视觉主干实现,即Contractive Torus吸引器网络(CTAN)。 通过将高维潜在空间纳入二维相平面的正向直接总和(⨁k = 1 K R 2\bigoplus_{k = 1}^{K}\mathb{R}^{2}),Ananke通过脱钩的双相连续流来坐标特征更新:skew-对称 汉密尔顿运输的特征是沿能量位位移动,以保持语义相位变量,同时签署梯度散射合同,通常向着目标相位变量移动。 对于有冷冻参数的循环型潜在家庭,对数射线反馈产生Exact Log-Sympletic Flow(ELSF),这是一种分析式封闭式映射,其精确指数衰减的对数射线误差在没有数字整合的情况下在一次前传中评价. 我们为水平设置偏差和对数辐射误差建立本地输入-状态界限,并描述理想产品托鲁斯在受限扰动下的正常双曲线性和持久性. 我们通过 Lie-Trotter 操作员的分割来进一步制定架构,将空间深度扩散与局部的多重收缩统一起来,并分析精确的三角流和硬件友好的双排变体。 在整个自然图像基准(CIFAR-100)和临床具有挑战性的内镜数据集(Kvasir-v2)中,CTAN显示出特殊参数效率:一个仅0.27M参数的超共性分级模型在Kvasir-v2上达到90.52%的精度,比25M+基线(ResNet-50,DenseNet-161)的精度高出近两个数量级,而规模化的变体在CIFAR-100上达到80.32%的最高精度-1。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Convolutional networks, residual networks, and vision transformers provide effective visual representations by cascading discrete spatial and channel transformations [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Complementary to static discrete layers, continuous-depth models interpret network depth as physical evolution time governed by ordinary differential equations (ODEs) [ 4 ] . However, designing continuous dynamical backbones for robust representation learning faces a fundamental dilemma: purely conservative (Hamiltonian or symplectic) flows preserve volume and energy but lack dissipative attraction to filter noise [ 5 , 6 ] , whereas globally contractive dynamics universally drive all feature trajectories toward a single trivial equilibrium, obliterating inter-class semantic separability.
blocks.zh: 串联式网络,残网,视变器通过串联式离散空间和通道转换[1,2,3]提供有效的视觉表现. 与静态离散层互补的连续深度模型将网络深度解释为受普通微分方程(ODE)支配的物理演化时间. [4]. 然而,为稳健的代表性学习设计持续的动态骨干面临着一个根本的两难问题:纯粹保守的(Hamiltonian或synmpletic)流量保存体积和能量,但缺乏过滤噪音的分散吸引力[5,6],而全球的收缩性动力普遍将所有特征轨迹推向单一的微小平衡,消除了阶级之间的分离性。

blocks.en: We resolve this tension by introducing Ananke 1 1 1 Named after Ananke in Plato’s Republic , our framework echoes the Spindle of Necessity through contraction toward structured invariant manifolds. , a representation-learning framework based on orthogonal symplectic-gradient geometric flows. Rather than presuming that arbitrary data manifolds are globally homeomorphic to a monolithic shape, Ananke adopts a Product-Torus Scaffolding Prior : in analogy to harmonic analysis where orthogonal circular functions serve as a universal basis to decompose signals, we factorize the latent space into an orthogonal direct sum of canonical two-dimensional phase planes ( ⨁ k = 1 K ℝ 2 \bigoplus_{k=1}^{K}\mathbb{R}^{2} , where D = 2 ​ K D=2K ). Each constituent circle acts as an elementary geometric scaffold, naturally decoupling feature dynamics into transverse gradient dissipation (filtering noise along the radial amplitude) and tangential Hamiltonian transport (encoding semantic variation along the phase). To adapt this canonical base to complex, multimodal distributions, a lightweight spatial context generator dynamically modulates local geometric parameters, effectively tailoring the scaffold to the specific data context.

blocks.en: To scale this formulation into an empirical visual backbone, we introduce Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN) . CTAN embodies an operator-split realization of continuous reaction–diffusion systems, alternating spatial depthwise convolution (diffusion) with exact closed-form manifold contraction (reaction).

blocks.en: The principal contributions of this work are: 1. Product-Torus Geometric Scaffolding: We introduce an orthogonal direct-sum factorization that scaffolds high-dimensional latent spaces into canonical 2D phase planes, establishing a principled, data-adaptive coordinate framework for decoupled radial regulation and phase transport. 2. Closed-Form Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF): We derive an exact, single-pass closed-form operator for circular geometries under logarithmic feedback, providing an analytical solution that incorporates radial-dependent twist dynamics without numerical overshooting. 3. Theoretical Grounding via Contraction and Normal Hyperbolicity: We establish local input-to-state stability (ISS) bounds for transverse level-set errors and circular log-radii, and prove the normal hyperbolicity and conditional persistence of the uncoupled product torus under bounded perturbations. 4. Operator-Split Vision Architecture and Empirical Validation: We construct hierarchical CTAN backbones integrating spatial diffusion with local geometric reaction across pure and residual topologies. On CIFAR-100 and Kvasir-v2, CTAN demonstrates state-of-the-art parameter efficiency, matching or exceeding heavyweight 25M+ convolutional and transformer baselines with up to 87 × 87\times fewer parameters.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Modern visual backbones predominantly evolve through modular heuristics: deep residual networks stabilize optimization via identity shortcuts [ 1 ] , vision transformers capture long-range token relationships via self-attention [ 2 ] , and modernized ConvNets leverage large-kernel depthwise convolutions [ 3 , 7 ] . Recently, geometric representation learning has explored algebraic structures, such as Clifford algebras and multivector products [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , and complex-valued neural networks that preserve amplitude–phase relationships [ 11 ] . The classical manifold hypothesis posits that high-dimensional sensory data concentrate near lower-dimensional submanifolds [ 12 ] . Ananke operationalizes this hypothesis by imposing an explicit product-torus prior, providing structured geometric scaffolding with provable transverse attraction and exact local solvability.
blocks.zh: 现代视觉骨干主要通过模块化的heuristic演化:深残留网络通过身份快捷键稳定优化[1],视觉变压器通过自意[2]捕捉远方的符号关系[2],现代化的ConvNet通过大内核深度回转[3,7]. 最近,几何表达学探索了代数结构,如克利福德代数和多变量产品[8,9,10],以及保存振幅-相位关系的复杂价值神经网络[11]. 古典的多重假说假设高维感官数据集中在下维子磁倍数附近[12]. Ananke将这一假说付诸实施,先强制使用一个明确的产品托盘,提供结构化的几何脚手架,具有可证明的横向吸引力和准确的局部溶解性。

blocks.en: Interpreting deep architectures as continuous dynamical systems has spurred the development of Neural ODEs [ 4 ] , Hamiltonian Neural Networks [ 5 ] , and Symplectic Networks [ 6 ] . In spatial modeling, PDE-Net connects learned convolutional filters to partial differential operators [ 13 ] . Operator splitting techniques, such as Lie–Trotter and Strang splitting, are classical foundations for separating spatial diffusion from local reaction kinetics in computational physics [ 14 ] . CTAN bridges these paradigms by structuring vision blocks into an operator-split reaction–diffusion pipeline: spatial depthwise convolution acts as spatial smoothing, while the closed-form ELSF executes exact local manifold contraction.
blocks.zh: 将深层建筑解释为连续的动态系统,推动了神经ODE[4],汉密尔顿神经网络[5],Symplectic Networks的发展. [6]. 在空间建模中,PDE-Net将学到的演化滤波器连接到部分差分操作器[13]. 操作员分裂技术,如Lie-Trotter和Strang分裂,是计算物理中空间扩散与局部反应动力学分离的经典基础[14]. CTAN通过将视觉块结构成一个操作员-分裂反应-分流管道来构建这些范式:空间深度演化作用于空间平滑,而封闭式ELSF则执行精确的局部多重收缩.

blocks.en: Contraction analysis investigates the convergence between trajectories using matrix logarithmic norms and one-sided Lipschitz conditions [ 15 , 16 ] . Unlike unconstrained global contraction, which collapses all representations to a single equilibrium, Ananke establishes transverse semicontraction: it enforces exponential contraction along the normal bundle to extinguish off-manifold perturbations, while preserving tangential Hamiltonian transport to sustain semantic discrimination. Furthermore, by framing the product torus within Normally Hyperbolic Invariant Manifold (NHIM) theory [ 17 ] , we characterize the conditional persistence of the underlying attractor geometry under smooth coupling perturbations.
blocks.zh: 收缩分析用矩阵对数规范调查轨迹与单侧利普希茨条件的趋同性[15,16]. 与不加约束的全球收缩(它使所有表述都崩溃为单一的平衡)不同,阿南克建立了横贯式半收缩:它沿着正常的捆绑执行指数收缩以消灭非狂躁的扰动,同时保留微小的汉密尔顿式运输以维持语义上的歧视. 此外,通过将产品托鲁斯设定在通常的超曲面 Invariant Manifold(NHIM)理论 [17] 中,我们描述在平滑耦合扰动下,基础吸引器几何的有条件持久性.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the representation capacity, parameter efficiency, and architectural scaling of CTAN across natural images (CIFAR-100) and clinically demanding endoscopy benchmarks (Kvasir-v2). All models are trained from scratch under standardized optimization protocols. Experimental configurations and dataset details are summarized below.
blocks.zh: 我们评价CTAN在自然图像(CIFAR-100)和临床要求的内镜学基准(Kvasir-v2)上的表达能力、参数效率和建筑规模。 所有模型都根据标准化优化协议从零开始训练. 实验配置和数据集细节概述如下.

blocks.en: 6.1 Natural image classification: CIFAR-100
blocks.zh: 6.1 自然图像分类:CIFAR-100

blocks.en: CIFAR-100 comprises 50,000 training and 10,000 test images across 100 fine-grained categories at 32 × 32 32\times 32 resolution [ 18 ] . To rigorously examine the interplay between geometric flows and spatial organization, we instantiate two architectural paradigms across two parameter scales: • Isotropic Models (CTAN-Iso): A 12-layer uniform backbone maintaining constant spatial resolution and channel width throughout depth: – CTAN-Iso-1: Width dim = 128 \text{dim}=128 ( K = 64 K=64 two-dimensional phase planes), comprising 0.97M parameters; – CTAN-Iso-2: Width dim = 160 \text{dim}=160 ( K = 80 K=80 two-dimensional phase planes), comprising 1.49M parameters. • Hierarchical Models (CTAN-Hier): A 3-stage pyramidal hierarchy with patch_size=1 (preserving spatial resolution in early stages) and progressive downsampling between stages: – CTAN-Hier-1: stage_depths=(3, 4, 5), stage_dims=(96, 128, 160), with shared rotation, yielding 0.91M parameters; – CTAN-Hier-2: stage_depths=(3, 6, 9), stage_dims=(96, 144, 192), with shared rotation, scaling to 1.89M parameters. – CTAN-Hier-3: stage_depths=(3, 6, 9), stage_dims=(96, 144, 192), with context-conditioned rotation, scaling to 2.13M parameters. All models are trained from scratch without external pretraining and evaluated against widely adopted lightweight CNNs, deep residual baselines, and state-of-the-art geometric architectures under matched training conditions.

blocks.en: As reported in Table 1 , CTAN backbones consistently establish superior parameter efficiency: • Outperforming Heavyweight ResNets with > 11 × >11\times Compression: CTAN-Hier-3 attains 80.32% top-1 accuracy with merely 2.13M parameters, outperforming the massive ResNet-50 baseline (79.14%, 23.7M parameters) by +1.18% while utilizing 11.1 × 11.1\times fewer parameters. blocks.en: 6.2 Gastrointestinal endoscopy: Kvasir-v2

blocks.en: Kvasir-v2 is a clinically demanding endoscopic dataset containing 8,000 images across eight pathological and anatomical classes [ 21 , 22 ] . Endoscopic imagery presents severe physical artifacts, including intense specular reflections, fluid bubbles, and non-uniform illumination. We evaluate two ultra-compact configurations trained from scratch at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution: CTAN-Nano (0.27M parameters) and CTAN-Tiny (1.12M parameters).

blocks.en: The product-torus scaffolding prior provides a structured geometric inductive bias by decomposing high-dimensional representations into orthogonal radial-phase coordinates. blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented Ananke and its visual realization CTAN , a continuous-time representation learning framework grounded in a product-torus scaffolding prior. By decoupling feature updates into normal gradient dissipation and tangential Hamiltonian transport, CTAN preserves semantic phase invariants while strictly contracting off-manifold disturbances. For circular potentials, the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF) provides an exact analytical mapping that evaluates in a single pass with zero truncation error. Framing the backbone through Lie–Trotter operator splitting seamlessly unifies spatial diffusion with local manifold contraction. Empirical evaluations on natural image and clinical endoscopy benchmarks demonstrate that CTAN establishes state-of-the-art parameter efficiency, confirming that structured, context-adaptive torus scaffolding provides a powerful and mathematically transparent foundation for next-generation visual backbones.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Ananke及其视觉实现CTAN,这是一个基于产品脚手架的连续时间表现学习框架。 CTAN通过将特征更新脱钩到正常的梯度消散和微小的汉密尔顿运输中,保留语义阶段的变异性,同时严格地收缩非狂扰. 对于循环潜力,Exact Log-Symplectic Flow(ELSF)提供了精确的分析映射,在一次通过中进行零调值误差的评价. 通过 Lie-Trotter 操作员将主干线分解,无缝地将空间传播与局部的多重收缩统一起来。 对自然影像和临床内光学基准的实证评价表明,CTAN确立了最先进的参数效率,证实了结构化,上下文化的托鲁斯脚手架为下一代视觉骨干提供了强大和数学透明的基础.
